title: AuraUtility
description: A lightweight, high-performance HUD utility mod providing Oxygen timers, Mending notifications, and low-health warnings.
body:
**AuraUtility**

AuraUtility is a lightweight client-side utility mod that adds small but
genuinely useful quality-of-life features. It's built for players who
want helpful information on screen without turning their HUD into a
mess.

Whether you're playing survival, PvPing, or working on technical builds,
AuraUtility gives you clean, subtle feedback exactly when you need it.

**Features**

**Mending Notifications**\
Get notified whenever an item is repaired with Mending and see exactly
which item was affected. You can choose where the notification appears
on your screen.

**Oxygen Timer**\
A precise digital timer appears while you're underwater so you know
exactly how many seconds you have left before drowning.

**Danger Borders**\
When your health drops below 3 hearts, a subtle red vignette flashes to
warn you during intense combat situations.

**Item Counter**\
See the total amount of a specific item across your entire inventory ---
not just your hotbar.

**Easy Configuration**\
Press the K key in-game to open the settings menu. Toggle features on or
off and change HUD colors instantly --- no restart required.

**Requirements**

Minecraft: 1.21
Loader: Fabric
Dependencies: Fabric API
